bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/room-terminal-53a31e2"
old="$r/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
new="$w/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-terminal-53a31e2
backup=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-before-terminal-53a31e2
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 53a31e2047e45a0e61fe9af780a4cfae0b131ef9 || exit 70
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 71
before_userbot=$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)
before_pg=$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')
old_img=$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')
test "$old_img" = "$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local --format '{{.Id}}')" || exit 72
new_img=$(docker image inspect "$tag" --format '{{.Id}}')
test -n "$new_img" && test "$new_img" != "$old_img" || exit 73
docker compose -p deploy -f "$new" --project-directory "$r/deploy" config -q || exit 74
docker tag "$old_img" "$backup"
rollback() {
 echo TERMINAL_DEPLOY_ROLLBACK_TRIGGERED
 docker tag "$backup" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$old" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || :
}
trap rollback ERR
docker tag "$tag" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
docker compose -p deploy -f "$new" --project-directory "$r/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs || exit 75
for i in $(seq 1 35); do
 if test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true && docker logs --since 4m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY; then break; fi
 sleep 1
done
docker logs --since 4m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY || exit 76
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.Image}}')" = "$new_img" || exit 77
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.RestartCount}}')" = 0 || exit 78
docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sh -c 'test "$GAYBBS_ROOM_EVENT_WORKER_ENABLED" = enabled && test "$GAYBBS_ROOM_STATUS_EDIT_ENABLED" = enabled' || exit 79
test "$(docker inspect deploy-postgres-1 --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$before_pg" || exit 80
test "$(systemctl --user show gace-userbot-verify.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$before_userbot" || exit 81
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -c "SELECT CASE WHEN pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%skipped%' THEN 'SKIPPED_ALLOWED' ELSE 'INVALID' END FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='room_status_message_edits'::regclass AND conname='room_status_message_edits_state_check'" | grep -qx SKIPPED_ALLOWED || exit 82
trap - ERR
echo ROOM_TERMINAL_IMAGE_PRODUCTION_PASS
echo ROOM_STATUS_MIGRATION_PASS
echo GAYBBS_READY_PASS
echo POSTGRES_AND_USERBOT_UNCHANGED_PASS
echo SOURCE_SHA=53a31e2047e45a0e61fe9af780a4cfae0b131ef9
